from pathlib import Path
path = Path('.github/workflows/agent-merge-gate.yml')
source = path.read_text().replace('  pull_request:\\n', '  pull_request:\\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\\n  workflow_dispatch:\\n')
source = source.replace("if: github.event_name == 'merge_group'", "if: github.event_name == 'merge_group' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/')")
source = source.replace('if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = merge_group ]; then', 'if [ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = merge_group ] || [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/heads/gh-readonly-queue/* ]]; then')
path.write_text(source)
